featured_reviews.name: aniket nawle
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Envi Salon! The overall service was excellent, and the staff was professional, friendly, and attentive. A special mention to Sohil for his outstanding service and expertise. He took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and delivered great results with attention to detail. His professionalism and customer care made the entire experience even better. Highly recommend Envi Salon, and be sure to ask for Sohil if you’re looking for top-quality service! 😊

featured_reviews.name: poojashree phatak
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited this salon on 31st Jan 2025 for my hair botox treatment and my mom’s hair color treatment. They charged premium prices and also sold me their shampoo and conditioner, saying it was necessary after the botox. The straightening machine they used was horrible and felt unsafe for my hair. I’ve done hair botox 2–3 times before at other salons, but I’ve never faced such severe hair fall and dandruff like I did after this treatment. If you genuinely care about your hair, I would not recommend this salon

featured_reviews.name: Shubadha Khandekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got a balayage done by Namrata, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! She took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and recommended shades that would complement my natural hair beautifully. The blending is flawless, the tones are gorgeous, and my hair looks so soft and dimensional.

What really stood out was her attention to detail and how comfortable she made the whole experience. She’s patient
, knowledgeable, and truly talented at her craft. I’ve received so many compliments already!

featured_reviews.name: Shashank AC-1385
featured_reviews.review_text: Huge shoutout to Imran! I came in for a haircut and beard trim, and he absolutely nailed it. He really took his time to understand what look I wanted and executed it perfectly. The lines on the beard are incredibly sharp, and the haircut looks fresh. Excellent service and great conversations. Will absolutely be coming back to him!

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Raorane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a pedicure here with my mom here.
Had a really great pedicure experience with the Ankita here. She was very professional, gentle, and paid attention to every detail. The service was hygienic, relaxing, and my feet felt super soft and refreshed afterward. She made me feel comfortable throughout the session and did an amazing job. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a clean and professional pedicure service!
She made sure that we are really enjoying the session throughout.
I highly recommend to have a session with ankita.
She is so gentle and sweet and made the session the best❤️

featured_reviews.name: Ruchita Rathod
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience with Mr. Sohil hairdresser. He listened carefully to what I wanted and gave me a haircut that suited me perfectly. His attention to detail, professionalism, and skill were impressive. The haircut exceeded my expectations, and I left feeling confident and happy with the result. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a talented and friendly hairdresser. Thank you for the excellent service!

featured_reviews.name: VISHAL TIVREKAR
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an amazing experience with Rani at the Envi Salon, Sion branch. She handled my haircut + hair spa, and I’m honestly so happy with the results.

1. Rani patiently understood what I wanted and suggested what would suit my face shape & hair texture. No pushing expensive treatments.
2.  Super precise haircut, zero complaints. My hair feels lighter and the layers are perfect.
3. Most relaxing 45 mins. She used great products and the head massage was excellent.
4. Warm, professional, and hygienic. Kept checking if water temp/pressure was ok.
5.  My hair looks healthy, shiny, and the style is exactly what I asked for.

The salon itself is clean and well-maintained. But Rani truly made the difference – she’s talented and genuinely cares about clients.

Highly recommend asking for Rani if you visit Envi Sion. Will definitely be back!

featured_reviews.name: Dhwani Khosla
featured_reviews.review_text: Rani is pure magic with hair! ✨ Loved my haircut and styling—she knew exactly what would suit me and executed it perfectly. Walked out feeling like the best version of myself. Highly recommend! ❤️
